subject: a tiny greenhouse around two leaves
art_direction: 一个顶针大小的透明温室罩着两片小叶，黄铜底座朴素细致。
visible_description: 一个顶针大小的透明温室罩着两片小叶，黄铜底座朴素细致。
composition: Square 1024x1024 avatar. The distinct subject, face, object or abstract form occupies about 65–80% of the canvas, and remains readable at small size. Important features sit safely near the center with room for a circular crop, but DO NOT draw a circular frame, badge, disc backdrop or circular mask. Render a complete square background. Vary silhouette, expression, angle, asymmetry, and density as the individual direction requests. Appealing eyes and a purposeful expression matter when a face is present; never force a face onto a faceless concept.
creative_direction: Build a thimble-sized glass greenhouse with a plain brass base, sheltering two broad green leaves. Tilt the dome slightly forward so the tiny plant is visible without distorted reflections. Keep the glass thick enough to show its rim and one restrained highlight. Warm side light on an ivory field reveals brass grain, making the miniature feel precise and tender. Square 1024x1024, centered with a distinct silhouette and generous circular-crop clearance, without a circular frame. Original peaceful design, no text, branding, or watermark.
